why: A regression gate that requires all verifiers green is impossible while these fail, and a gate that is impossible gets disabled - which is what happened (run_loop.py passed run_regressions=False). This file records the failures that exist INDEPENDENTLY of any proposal, so the gate can require NO NEW failures instead of no failures at all.
how_to_change: Removing an entry requires evidence the failure was FIXED, not that it became inconvenient. Adding an entry requires the same, in reverse: a recorded reason why the failure cannot be attributed to any proposal. Editing this file to make a proposal pass is the exact abuse it exists to prevent.

failures.why_not_a_live_defect: This verifier validates the OLDEST of three baseline generations (evobot_capability_freeze_20261111 -> evobot_freeze_change_20261111 -> benchmark/capability_baseline.json). It was legitimately superseded twice and never retired or redirected, so it fails permanently on files that are supposed to have changed.
failures.what_would_fix_it: Retire it or point it at benchmark/capability_baseline.json. Requires human approval: it is committed evidence.

failures.why_not_a_live_defect: It pre-registered 'no displacement/push clause: push appears nowhere in the evaluator goal handling'. Commit 0dc1245b ADDED the push clause, fixing exactly the deficiency this record documented. It fails because the world got BETTER.
failures.what_would_fix_it: Retire it, or re-express it as a dated premise. Requires human approval.

failures.why_not_a_live_defect: NOT INVESTIGATED. Recorded here as a known failure so the gate can function, NOT because it has been shown harmless. Its cause is UNKNOWN and it must not be treated as benign.
failures.what_would_fix_it: Investigate. Until then it cannot be attributed to any proposal, which is the only claim this entry makes.

failures.why_not_a_live_defect: NOT INVESTIGATED. Same caveat as above: recorded so the gate can function, with cause UNKNOWN.
